# ChiralSymmetryClasses

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Symmetry classes in the tenfold way that possess a chiral (sublattice) symmetry, leading to distinct topological phases and Anderson transitions. These classes are relevant for designing topologically protected interconnects and fault-tolerant routing in TCC architectures.
